title: Module 5 Quiz: Building a Trading Plan

questions.text: According to the defined strategy, which condition must be satisfied before placing an entry order?
options: The candle closes completely above the identified support or resistance level
The candle opens above the identified level
The price merely touches the identified level during the session
Any positive market sentiment is sufficient
questions.explanation: Entry is allowed only after a confirmed candle close beyond the key level.

questions.text: True or false: The pre‑market routine should begin at least thirty to forty‑five minutes before the market opens.
questions.explanation: A early pre‑market check gives time to assess news, chart levels, and risk limits.

questions.text: Which performance metric is obtained by dividing gross profits by gross losses?
questions.explanation: Profit Factor equals total gross profit divided by total gross loss.

questions.text: True or false: The invalidation point (stop‑loss) is set to define the maximum acceptable profit target.
questions.explanation: The invalidation point limits loss, not profit, and protects capital if the trade fails.
